title: Uhlmann Pac-Systeme - CNBC
content: Family Affair: Rise of the Mittelstand. # Uhlmann Pac-Systeme. Uhlmann Pac-Systeme GmbH & Co. KG. Specializing in pharmaceutical packaging for more than 60 years, southern Germany based Uhlmann employs roughly 1,600 people worldwide and has a presence everywhere from Brazil to Singapore. Founded in 1948 by Josef Uhlmann, the company started out by manufacturing "precision molds for the production of suppositories." Eight years later, Uhlmann designed the HS30, described by the company as the "world's first universal strip packaging machine.". Friedrich Uhlmann, Josef's son, joined the company in 1963. In 2007, Tobias Uhlmann - the third generation of the Uhlmann family to be involved with the company - became chairman of the supervisory board of the Uhlmann Group, which reported a turnover of 260 million euros for 2013/14. title: World's Top 10 Blister Machine Manufacturers - Yundu
content: ## **What is a Blister Machine?**. A blister machine, also known as a blister packaging machine, is a type of equipment used to create blister packs, which are pre-formed plastic packaging commonly used for small consumer goods, pharmaceuticals, and industrial products. The machine forms a cavity (blister) from a roll of plastic film, fills it with the product, and seals it with a backing material, such as aluminum foil or cardboard. ## **In which fields is a Blister Machine used most?**. Blister machines are widely used across various industries due to their ability to provide secure and efficient packaging. Blister machines are valued for their precision, speed, and ability to create tamper-evident and visually appealing packaging.
